asset_role: visual-only whitewater breakup mask multiplied by solver-authored aeration; no hydraulic, collision, wet-mask, bathymetry, or raft-force authority
generation_method: project-directed generation of an orthographic sparse Pacuare whitewater lace and downstream bubble-train mask
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable game data texture; grayscale foam-lace mask for solver-masked Unreal Engine river-water rendering. Primary request: create a square seamless grayscale mask for sparse rain-fed Pacuare River whitewater foam at Upper Huacas in Costa Rica. Use a black-dominant field covering at least 75 percent of the image, with narrow irregular branching lace, broken diagonal crest fragments, elongated downstream bubble trains, turbulent holes, fine edge froth, and intermittent humid-tropical river aeration patterns. Style/medium: production game data mask, not a beauty image; white means foam breakup coverage and black means no foam. Composition/framing: orthographic square, edge-to-edge, distributed non-repeating detail, no focal point, suitable for mirrored addressing. Color palette: grayscale only; deep black dominant with sparse white and gray filaments. Constraints: crisp organic multi-scale mask intended to be multiplied by live solver foam and speed channels; no text, watermark, logo, banks, rocks, raft, people, colored water, normal-map colors, lighting, shadow, or perspective. Avoid: broad opaque white sheets, uniform noise, regular stripes, cellular honeycomb, regular dots, obvious spirals, hard seams, and photographs.

texture.encoding: RGB grayscale breakup mask sampled from the red channel

limitations: The asset is procedural visual infill rather than measured Pacuare foam imagery or rapid-specific calibration.
Mirrored GPU addressing is required because opposite source-image borders are not byte-identical.
The material must multiply this texture by solver-derived foam and speed channels so it cannot paint whitewater into calm or dry cells.
In-engine visual, guide, water-VFX, and target-hardware acceptance remain required.
